name: Patron Mission Objectives
notes: To Win the battle, you must achieve the objective (even if you are subsequently chased from the battlefield, unless the objective states otherwise). If this is the final battle of a Quest, it is always a Fight Off objective and you must add +1 to the number of enemies faced.

rows.detail: A crew member of your choosing is carrying a package that must be delivered to the exact center of the table (placing it requires a Combat Action). If the carrier becomes a casualty, roll 1D6: on a 1, the item is destroyed; otherwise it can be picked up by spending a Combat Action at the location they fell. If you drive off all enemies, you Win as long as the package is undamaged.

Select a random enemy figure as the target. If they are killed, you Win. If the target would Bail, put a marker next to them and leave them in place: for the next round they cannot move, but may shoot and fight normally. If you fail to kill them in this final round, they escape and the mission has failed.
You Win if at least 2 crew members move off the opposing battlefield edge. If you drive off all enemies, you Win as long as you have at least 2 crew members remaining.

You must end 2 consecutive rounds with crew within 2" of the center of the table. A crew member with an enemy within 6" of them does not count. If you drive off the opposition, you can complete the objective at your leisure.

You are accompanied by a VIP (Reactions 1 / 4" / +0 / 3), unarmed, never initiates a Brawl, cannot be given equipment; treat them as a crew member. The VIP sets up at least 12" from the center; the enemy sets up 12" from the center on their side. If the VIP spends a full round within 3" of the center, you Win; within the first 4 rounds earns an additional 2 credits in pay.
There is no objective other than driving off the enemy. To Win, you must Hold the Field.
